# PDF.js upstream distribution

Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.5.438

Archive: `pdfjs-6.5.438-dist.zip` (official GENERIC viewer, release 6.5.438).

Archive SHA-256: `fcbe9ba21d9911843e3502adc178a7f549a524a4055f887bedc942e5490c6ba1`.
The digest was checked against the release asset metadata from GitHub.

Upstream build modules, the complete viewer, translations, images, fonts,
CMaps, and WebAssembly dependencies are included unchanged. Source maps and
the upstream demonstration PDF were omitted. `web/guanyi.css` is the local
host toolbar/theme integration stylesheet. The JavaScript adapter lives in
`../../js/pdf-reader.js` and does not replace rendering or annotation editing.

See `LICENSE` and individual resource notices for licenses.
